title: An off-by-one error in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow an attacker with hypervisor…
description: An off-by-one error in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow an attacker with hypervisor access to corrupt the Reverse Map Table (RMP), potentially compromising guest memory integrity. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating and does not currently have a known exploit in the wild. No affected versions or patches are specified.
